answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the harbor index resolves every citation against the fable checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the ferrous audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 4295 identities would post 1220 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
